references.text: Lot gets drunk and sleeps with his daughters, illustrating how alcohol can lead to sin and shame.
Proverbs warns against the deceptive nature of wine: 'Wine is a mocker, strong drink is brawling; whoever stumbles because of it is not wise.'
Isaiah pronounces woe on those who are mighty to drink wine and valiant at mixing strong drink.
Isaiah describes how priests and prophets stumble from wine and strong drink, failing in their duties.
Habakkuk pronounces woe on the one who makes his neighbor drunk by giving him wine, so as to gaze upon his nakedness—a direct parallel to Noah's situation.
Lamentations mentions getting drunk and exposing oneself, which has a direct thematic connection to Noah's drunkenness and nakedness.
